description: Simulate downstream effects before allowing consequential agent actions — dry-run the blast radius, then approve or deny.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; app.js was rewritten cleanly against the real shared/kit.js contract after a patch-script brace accident.

notes.note: Compressing human review into 'what breaks' is the right insight for keeping approval fast enough for agents. Weakest assumption: you can simulate side effects faithfully — that requires live cloud-inventory connectors and a model of the customer's infra, which is enormously hard and is the whole company. Without that, the simulation number is theater.
Dry-run simulation populates blast-radius result; approve/deny work; zero errors.

notes.change: Simulation now auto-runs on load (magic moment lands in ~4s, no click needed); added terraform-plan-style diff grouped by resource type with per-type savings + named kept resources (README next-3 #2).
